query: SELECT TOP 1000 source_id,random_index,ref_epoch,ra,dec,parallax,parallax_error,parallax_over_error,pmra,pmdec,radial_velocity,phot_g_mean_mag,ruwe FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE random_index BETWEEN 0 AND 300000 AND parallax > 0 AND parallax_over_error >= 10 AND ruwe > 0 AND ruwe < 1.4 AND phot_g_mean_mag < 17 ORDER BY random_index
scope: Fixed small random_index window, high-quality astrometric subset; NOT all stars or a representative volume census.
distance_caveat: 1000/parallax mas is a high-SNR approximate distance, NOT a calibrated posterior; missing RV remains null.
